The 'BrandingSettings: uploads' tests of components/branding-settings.test.tsx, run against main's
components/project-settings/branding-section.tsx (run at 72db23107; the file is identical at the current merge base a72e5f398) with mutate() shims on the same mocks.
All 10 fail on main. Every one passes on this branch. The first assertion that failed in each:

- fills only its own field, never saves, and the route guard sees the filled draft
    AssertionError: expected "vi.fn()" to be called with arguments: [ 'settings.branding.uploaded', …(1) ]
- keeps the value and names the field once when an upload fails
    AssertionError: expected "vi.fn()" to be called with arguments: [ …(2) ]
- does not overwrite a field typed in while its upload ran
    AssertionError: expected 'https://cdn.example/assets/light.svg' to be '/typed-meanwhile.svg' // Object.is equality
- does not refill a field cleared while its upload ran
    AssertionError: expected 'https://cdn.example/assets/favicon.png' to be '' // Object.is equality
- does not re-dirty a draft discarded before the upload finished
    Error: No forms.discard button in the save bar
- never fills another site's form, nor reports there, when the first site's upload settles
    AssertionError: expected 'https://cdn.example/assets/a-light.svg' to be '/b-light.svg' // Object.is equality
- drops a result from an earlier visit after A → B → A
    AssertionError: expected { …(4) } to deeply equal { logoLight: '/logo/light.svg', …(3) }
- runs uploads for different fields side by side, each with its own progress and result
    AssertionError: expected [ false, false, true ] to deeply equal [ true, false, true ]
- starts one upload per field at a time
    AssertionError: expected "vi.fn()" to be called 1 times, but got 2 times
- a save during an upload sends the draft as it is, and the upload then fills a new draft
    Error: No common.save button in the save bar
    TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'then')

Race regressions that fail on main for the race itself:
- a field typed in or cleared during its upload is overwritten by the late URL;
- an upload started on site A fills the form after switching to B, and after A -> B -> A, when the form instance is reused
  (the editor host keys the section by site today, which hides this there; the toast still fires);
- one shared uploading marker: a second field's upload clears the first one's progress;
- choosing a file again for a busy field starts a second upload.
